instruction: Remove all stars from emails in the Bills folder

rules.sql: select count(*) = 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing stars from all emails in Bills folder (folderID=13). The evaluator checks that no messages in folder 13 have star attribute (attributeID=58, value=1). Verified from database: folder 13 has 2 emails, attribute 58 represents 'star'. SQL returns 1 (true) if count is 0, meaning no starred emails.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly identifies starred emails: checks attributeID=58 (star), value=1 (starred state), and folderID=13 (Bills folder)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies ALL requirements - checks the specific folder and ensures NO emails have stars
Correct verification logic: SQL 'count(*) = 0' returns 1 when no starred emails exist (task completed), 0 otherwise (task failed)
Practical implementation: postconfig closes Thunderbird to prevent database lock, database file path is correct, SQL query is valid and will execute at runtime
Data flow is sound: vm_file getter fetches SQLite database -> run_sqlite3 executes query -> returns boolean result
Expected value semantics are correct: the SQL query itself performs the verification and returns the appropriate pass/fail signal

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric run_sqlite3 first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
